.commandments/.state-format:
format: 5
-----
Which format code-commandments writes its session state files in. It exists so an upgrade can convert what is already on disk exactly once.

The block above the first divider is this file's state, one `name: value` per line:
  format  the state-file format this project has been brought up to

Safe to delete — the conversion simply runs again on the next `composer update`.
